name: 34135 · Bonita Spgs, FL
findings: ZIP 34135 (Bonita Spgs) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34135 (Bonita Spgs) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 19 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
